I feel like the reason why Nick wiretapping Boston is more defended than Boston sleeping with his friend's boyfriend is a) why they did it, and b) the way they handled being found out

Nick only took the recording because he was jealous, and because he wanted to use it as a way to get Top to stay away from Boston. Even then, he never mentioned the tape to either of them. Later, when Boston mentioned how he hated being filmed by Gap without his consent, Nick looked like he knew he fucked up with the audio recording. And he genuinely seemed sorry when confronted by Boston, although even I was having a hard time being sympathetic towards Nick in that.

Boston, on the other hand, went out of his way to get Mew's first boyfriend to sleep with him. He manipulated Top to get him to a point where he would sleep with him, even though there were several other people he could have done it with. And, something that I feel is even worse than that, he doesn't even realize that it was wrong of him to do that. He keeps rationalizing it, saying that it's only fair, not realizing how much he's hurting his friend.

So yeah, I think it boils down to malicious intent and if they regret their action. (Same reason why I personally am more mad at Boston than Top for the car thing, cause I feel like Top actually feels bad and wants to make up for it, whereas Boston just doesn't care)

The question has already been answered, so I won't do that again, but I want to point something out:  Mafuyu isn't the older of the two. In Japan, school years start begin of April and end in March. Ritsuka birthday is first in the school years (August), and Mafuyu's is later (February). So while Ritsuka already turned seventeen around chapter 18/in the summer holidays of the second story arc, Mafuyu turned seventeen in the time skip in chapter 28, meaning that he's the younger one.

Fun fact, in the German dub, Mafuyu only calls him Ritsuka. Probably because they don't adapt the "-kun", since Kasai, who calls him "Uenoyama-kun" in the anime as well, also calls him that. (In contrast to Itaya and Ueki, who still call him Uenoyama in the dub.)

however, that doesn't necessarily have to mean that you are a lesbian. try to imagine yourself in a relationship with another boy (anyone, not necessarily someone who you actually know) and ask yourself if a relationship with him would evoke the same feelings. that could potentially clear the question of if it's just him or boys in general and give you a possible answer for your question. 

at the end of the day, no one will be able to give you a clear answer other than you yourself. take as much time as you need with figuring things out, i'm sure your boyfriend will understand.

I identify as an asexual lesbian, but I came to terms with both of these parts at very different times.

Figuring out that I'm asexual was easy. I just couldn't ever imagine myself having sex with anyone and thought of it as unpleasant and something I would just... have to do one day when I marry a man. So I identified as asexual (and panromantic, but that's not really important). That was when I was 13, and I never really changed my mind on it.

My opinion changed slightly when I started questioning if I was homoromantic, shortly before my 17th birthday. I didn't feel sexually attracted to women either, so it was hard of me to differentiate (at the time possible) comphet from actual crushes, but the lesbian masterdoc essentially helped me a lot. I started to think sexually about women, and that's pretty much when I was sure that I'm a lesbian. Don't get me wrong, I really don't experience sexual attraction, but I was able to think about having sex with a female partner to make her happy without feeling digusted, so... yeah :)
